_comment: The web's fixed lines (TD v0.40–v0.46, The Web of Secrets), transcribed from Characters v0.12, Shared Canon: Relationships (the Web of Secrets). `types`: the six fixed relationship types (TD v0.44), each with its label and what it covers; every connection uses one. `public`: the connections everyone knows, each with its type and its public line, as Characters' table writes them. `private`: each character's own connections, from their row of Characters' table, each line word for word from that character's briefing (its Relationships bullet for the guest, first letter capitalised), seen only by that character.

romance.label: Romance
romance.covers: Lovers, courtship, a love that's hoped for

service.label: Service
service.covers: One serves or protects the other (a bodyguard, a guard, a confessor)

alliance.label: Alliance
alliance.covers: The same side, or a friendship of use

money.label: Money
money.covers: A debt, a payment owed, a purse one controls

public.line: Brothers, sons of the late Lorenzo. Piero is the elder and the heir
Brother and sister. Francesco heads the Pazzi house
Lupo is the Pazzi bodyguard, and Francesco is the man he keeps alive
LeNoir is captain of the Prince's guard
France's ambassador, who is arranging the Prince's marriage
The Prince is choosing a Florentine bride, and Clarice is one of the two he is choosing between
The Prince is choosing a Florentine bride, and Giorgia is one of the two he is choosing between
Rivals for the Prince's hand. Clarice once mocked Giorgia at a banquet as "the Pazzi girl with nothing left"
Heads of the two rival houses. In 1478 a Pazzi plot killed Piero's uncle, and a Pazzi uncle hanged for it
Fra Tommaso preaches against the Medici and everything they stand for
Fra Tommaso leads the Dominican order Sister Beatrice serves
Fra Tommaso leads the Dominican order the widowed Contessa joined

Lupo.line: Your employer. Hot-headed. Keep him breathing.
Your employer's sister, sharper than her brother. Her night walks are her business, for now.
Your sister. Her silence keeps you alive; her conscience is a blade at your throat.
Your old client. She can ruin you and you can ruin her. She also has coin.
Piero's brother, a soldier with a gambler's habits. If any Medici is taking French coin, he's the sort.

Contessa Isabella.line: Your old instrument. He knows what you did; you know what he is. He can be paid.
The brother of the man you had killed. Keep him far from the truth.
Your debtor. Forgiving the debt is something you could trade.
Leader of your order. His public blessing would make your piety unquestionable.
A healer of your order, widely respected. You know nothing more of her.

Captain Armand LeNoir.line: Your sworn charge. Keep him alive.
Your secret lover. She could make you happiest or destroy you.
A soldier you respect and have encouraged. A Florentine noble can ask questions your uniform can't; he might help you trace the seal.
Your ambassador. Cautious, and wary of your passions. She doesn't need to know everything.

Raffaello de' Medici.line: Your brother, the heir. You love him and can't stand standing behind him.
Your cousin, sharper than both of you.
A soldier you respect, who seems to respect you. He wants his brother's killer; you'd like to be the one who finds him.
Your creditor. Gracious in public; her letters are not.
Your family's old enemy. You've heard he respects nerve more than money.

Francesco Pazzi.line: Your secret love. You'd risk a great deal for her.
Your family's enemy, and soft. He must not rule.
Piero's brother. A braggart, but at least he has nerve.
Your sister. Clever, and too quick to think she should lead.
A friar worth winning, if he can be bought without being trusted.

Giorgia Pazzi.line: The prize. Polished, young, and watched by everyone.
Your secret lover, and the man at Emile's shoulder.
Your rival for Emile. You'd enjoy seeing her lose.
Your brother. Brave, reckless, and loud.
The family's bodyguard. Loyal to Francesco, as far as you know.

Piero de' Medici.line: Your brother. Charming, reckless, and better liked than you.
Your cousin. Clever, and courted by the French Prince.
Head of the house that killed your uncle.
France's ambassador. Gracious, and generous with other people's money.
A friar who wants your family humbled.

Clarice Orsini.line: Your cousin, the heir. Vain, and not as foolish as he looks.
Your cousin. Better company than Piero, and worse with money.
The French prize. Polite, young, and hard to read.
Your rival for Emile, and Francesco's sister.
The ambassador who decides whom the Prince marries.

Fra Tommaso.line: A sinner who may yet be God's tool.
The heir to everything you preach against.
Respected, and a little too fond of books.
France's ambassador, and no friend to the friars.

Sister Beatrice.line: Your brother. A soul to save and a secret to keep.
Your Order's leader, and an ally if he can see that faith and learning can live together.
A sister of your cause, as far as you know.
Heir to a family that has paid for learning.

Jeanne d'Orléans.line: Your love, and the piece you are meant to play.
The favourite, and the obvious man to put on France's payroll.
The two candidates for Emile's hand.
The two candidates for Emile's hand.
Loyal to Emile, hot-tempered, and not always discreet.

Emile de Valois.line: Your secret love, and the woman deciding your marriage.
A fine match, and hard to read.
Your guard. Loyal, and too protective.
The men whose families want your name.
The men whose families want your name.
